articles.title: Sudan gold mine collapse leaves more than 80 dead
articles.author: Nicholas Mwangi
articles.content_excerpt: At least 82 bodies had been recovered, according to local officials and activists, while dozens of other miners were feared trapped or missing. The latest figure represents an increase from the 67 deaths earlier reported by the Sudan Doctors Network as rescue operations continued. The collapse occurred in an area controlled by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which has been fighting Sudan’s military since April 2023. The continuing war has severely weakened state institutions and access to basic services across large parts of the country. Limited rescue efforts In a statement , the Sudan Doctors Network said they lacked basic safety and protective measures required at mining sites. articles.title: Press TV condemns Israeli abduction of West Bank correspondent Naqaa Hamed
articles.author: Abdul Rahman
articles.content_excerpt: Iranian news outlet Press TV called the detention of its West Bank correspondent Naqaa Hamed by the Israeli forces an “aggressive terrorist operation” aimed at silencing the truth about its occupation and genocide of Palestinians. It demanded the immediate intervention of the international community for her release. “The desperate attempt by the Zionist war and security machine to block the flow of free news and boycott structured crimes in the West Bank is clear evidence of the occupier’s fear of independent” reporters “who expose widespread human right violations,” the Press TV statement , published on Thursday, September 17, said. articles.title: Health workers demand action against genocide and militarization at ManiFiesta 2026
articles.author: Peoples Health Dispatch
articles.content_excerpt: Health is always a prominent topic at Belgium’s ManiFiesta, a two-day festival organized by the Workers’ Party of Belgium (PTB) in the beginning of September. Discussions range from the organization of health services or workshops led by progressive health organizations like Medics for the People (MPLP-GVHV) and Viva Salud. articles.title: Recolonization is taking place, says Guyana’s former president
articles.author: BreakThrough News
articles.content_excerpt: Latin America and the Caribbean countries are being re-colonized. This time it is not by Britain, the Netherlands, Spain, France, and Portugal, but by the United States. At a period of time the United States had an anti-colonial position and had advocated for the ending of colonialism. That was one of the features of the Monroe Doctrine that has become somewhat obscured since the US became so bellicose. Today, in a de facto way it has become a super colonial power. It is imposing its will on regions and countries. Those that stand up for their rights are sanctioned, destabilized and sometimes physically removed. articles.title: A Rhetorical History of Modern Money Theory with John T. Harvey
articles.author: Scott Ferguson
articles.content_excerpt: We speak with John T. Harvey about a new article he co-wrote with Billy Saas titled, “A Rhetorical History of Modern Money Theory,” out this month in the September 2026 issue of the Journal of Economic Issues. Harvey is Hal Wright Professor of Economics at Texas Christian University. We discuss his recent publication in the context of his broader career in heterodox economics.
